gradientEvidence.method: Nonzero saved AdamW first/second moments after five real-data backward/step calls; encoder and physical head have moments and weight changes

limitations: Only one source dog, one five-frame window and two approved state observations.
The exposed reviewer is not an independent reference.
Front C anatomical left/right remains UNKNOWN; output is bound to this source and span.
Training-set loss/fit only; no validation or held-out/generalization accuracy.
No accurate event timing, clinical validity, complete stride or other-dog performance claim.
The auxiliary head can memorize sequence phase or pose context and does not locate a physical paw in a new clip.
Intervening frames 47–49 and every other unapproved/disputed/provisional/UNKNOWN state remain masked.
Gradient evidence comes from nonzero saved AdamW moments; direct per-step gradient norms were not logged.
Exactly one five-epoch optimization run; no second experiment or hyperparameter search.
